## Should fix before opening

**F1 · P2 · performance/regression**: `src/modules/spaces/domain/address-books/address-book-requests.repository.ts:198-214`
- **What:** `reject` always does three things inside the transaction: a space lookup (`:199`), a request read, and a KMS decrypt (`:202`, via `findOneOrFail`). It does them before the conditional UPDATE. `SpaceAuditRepository.record` returns early when `features.spaceAuditLog` is off (`space-audit.repository.ts:43`), so with the flag off the decrypted values are never used. They're also wasted when the request is no longer pending (`rejected === false`).
- **Why it matters:** reject used to be a single UPDATE. Now a slow or failing KMS makes reject fail with a 500, even with auditing disabled. It also holds a pooled DB connection open during the KMS round-trip.
- **Fix:** do the UPDATE first and only read and decrypt when `rejected` is true. Optionally skip the decrypt entirely when auditing is off. `create` has the same extra space lookup at `:139` (a cheap query, no KMS).
